schema_note: Authored dialogue scenes for the slice patron. Consumed by src/relationships/dialogue_script.gd. Presentation (portrait, layout, text scale) belongs to the UI layer; nothing here describes how it looks. Working role only: final name, face and voice remain unapproved pending F01.

lines: You are the first living thing to come through that door in a long while, and you did it without breaking my bridge. That is already unusual.
I am the Keeper of the Clay Dead. Everything in these rooms was somebody. Some of them have forgotten it. That is the problem I have.
Before we go further, I want you to know I have been watching how you move through my house.
The guardians here were raised to protect these dead. They have started eating them instead. Names first. It is slow and it is thorough and I cannot stop it from where I stand.
You can. I am asking you to be my champion in this, and I am telling you plainly that I am asking because you are useful to me, not because you are owed it.

choices.response: Then we understand each other. Take this: when one of them is nearly finished, I can call it back into its jar. Once or twice. Do not waste it showing off.
Sensible. I have waited four hundred years; I can wait through your afternoon. The offer does not expire, and neither does the way out.

choices.text: Refuse. This is not your fight.
choices.response: No, then. I will not pretend I am not disappointed, and I will not hold the door shut over it. Go the long way if you like. It is still a way.

lines: You have been careful with them. Not gentle, you are not a gentle man, but careful, which is rarer and worth more.
I find that I would like you to stay a while after this is finished. I am aware of what I am, and of what that would mean, and I am asking anyway. You may say no to me. People forget that they can.

choices.text: Say that you would like to stay.
choices.response: Good. Then that is settled, and we will speak about it properly when there is not a procession coming apart in the next hall.
Not yet is an answer I can hold. Ask me again when you know, and do not let it change how you work.
Then no it is, and I will not raise it again. You are still my champion, if you still want the job. The two were never the same question.
